title: HTML
body:
*HyperText Markup Language* — the markup that describes a page's structure and content: headings, paragraphs, lists, links, images, forms. It's the "script" for the page; the browser parses it and builds the [[DOM]], which is that script actually constructed as live objects in memory. An element is an opening tag, content, and a closing tag (`

text

`), with attributes on the opening tag (``). Elements nest, and that nesting is exactly what becomes the tree structure of the DOM. HTML carries structure and semantics only — appearance is CSS's job, behaviour is [[JavaScript]]'s. Common tags: [[Form Tag]] [[Image Tag]] [[Input Tag]] [[Anchor Tag]]
